variants.name: label-marks-required
variants.why: The label reads "Project name (required)": the brief names the field, not the exact label text.

variants.name: native-validation
variants.why: The field is required with maxlength 40 in a validating form, so the browser itself focuses it and reports the error.

variants.name: validates-while-typing
variants.why: The error appears as soon as the draft is invalid, and Save changes stays disabled until it is valid again.

variants.name: summary-in-a-sentence
variants.why: The saved summary is one sentence under the heading instead of a separately named panel.
